description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research, and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究,以及主动提议。
